questions.text: A gallery hangs 12 paintings in each of its 5 rooms. How many paintings in total?
A snooker player pots a red, then the black. How many points?
Which word can go before all of these to make new words: BOARD, HOLE, NOTE?
When it is noon on Christmas Day in London, it is 11pm in Sydney. What date is it in Sydney?
questions.why: Sydney is 11 hours ahead in December, so noon on the 25th in London is 11pm on the 25th there.

questions.text: How many of the letters in MISSISSIPPI are either an I or an S?
questions.why: M-I-S-S-I-S-S-I-P-P-I has four Is and four Ss: 4 + 4 = 8.

questions.text: If it takes 5 machines 5 minutes to make 5 widgets, how long does it take 100 machines to make 100 widgets?
questions.why: Each machine takes 5 minutes to make one widget, so 100 machines make 100 widgets in the same 5 minutes.

questions.text: The six friends each hug every other friend exactly once. How many hugs is that?
questions.why: Each of 6 hugs 5 others, 30, but every hug is counted twice, so 15.

questions.text: A man looks at a portrait and says 'Brothers and sisters I have none, but that man's father is my father's son.' Who is in the portrait?
questions.why: He has no brothers, so "my father's son" is himself, which makes the man in the portrait his son.

questions.text: In a knockout tennis tournament with 128 players, how many matches are played in total?
questions.why: Each match knocks out one player, and 127 players must go out to leave one winner.

questions.text: On an old calculator, which number do you type so that the display turned upside down reads 'hELLO'?
questions.why: 0.7734 upside down: 4 looks like h, 3 like E, the 7s like Ls and 0 like O.

questions.text: Which two-digit number is exactly twice the product of its two digits?
questions.why: 3 × 6 = 18, and 18 × 2 = 36. No other two-digit number works.
